budget_derivation: ceil(European 50 epochs * 50000 TRAIN targets / American 200000 TRAIN targets)=13 full epochs; 4% more target presentations, all original TRAIN rows each epoch
cache_policy: Complete immutable TRAIN cache gate before13epoch fit; heldout computed once without persistent prepared cache
checkpoint_policy: Every complete epoch retains model, optimizer and RNG state; only fixed epoch13 checkpoint authorizes heldout predictions

context.site_seed: rank of unique original focal coordinate within parent

input_adaptation.cohort_channels: ADMIX=0,EUR=1,EAS=2,AFR=3; remaining observed cohort channels unused
input_adaptation.focal_genotype: Use exact observed SNP if coordinate matches; otherwise all -1 missing with allele count1. Never move canonical midpoint.

loss_weight_explanation: Uniform per-parent window permutation; parent ceil(W/16) batches including each tail; allB_total updates equally weighted in expectation.
objective: W_parent*B_total/(B_parent*S*N)*sum CE; B_parent=ceil(W_parent/16), exact expected canonical-target weighting for parent-grouped tails
